book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: CARTA ALAXTO TET ANMA HEBREO AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM DIOS

content: Yuxin yakꞌ isba chito haltelax joc yin̈ huneꞌ xewilal chakꞌ Comam Dios, huneꞌ haltebilcano yu Comam, yuxin caw yilal cheyil heba, tajca ayex mach chexoc yin̈ huneꞌ xewilal tuꞌ.
Yuto hallaxpaxo Tzotiꞌ yet colbanile jet hacaꞌ yu yallax tet ebnaj tuꞌ, yajaꞌ xin matzet iswatxꞌe yin̈ ebnaj yet yaben ebnaj, yuto mach yaco yanma ebnaj yin̈.
Wal han̈on̈ xajayto yul janma yin̈ Comam chon̈oc yin̈ huneꞌ xewilal chal Comam tuꞌ. Yu chal yul Yum Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Walan yin̈ inbihan yu inhowalan tato maẍticꞌa chiocto huntekꞌan anma tiꞌ yul huneꞌ xewbal chiwakꞌan, ẍi Comam, ẍiayoj.

content: Yin̈ caw yeli hataxticꞌa yet iswatxꞌencano Comam Dios sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ isxew Comam yin̈ ismunil,
yuto chal yul Yum Comam Dios yin̈ ishuj tzꞌayic hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Xew Comam yin̈ ishuj tzꞌayic yin̈ sunil tzet iswatxꞌe, ẍiayoj.
Huntekꞌan anma tiꞌ mach chiocto yin̈ huneꞌ xewbal chiwakꞌan, ẍiayoj.

content: Yajaꞌ yilal ayto mac chiocto yin̈ huneꞌ xewilal tuꞌ tinan̈, yuto tet ebnaj Israel bay babel hallax Tzotiꞌ yet colbanile, yajaꞌ mach octo ebnaj yin̈ huneꞌ xewbal tuꞌ yu isman̈cꞌomal.
Yuxin ay huneꞌ tiempohal yebilcano yu Comam Dios, haꞌ ton huneꞌ tiempohal bay ayon̈ tiꞌ tinan̈. Payxatax halbilcano yin̈ huneꞌ xewbal tiꞌ, yakꞌnipaxo Comam yalaꞌ naj David yul Yum Comam, bay chala:

content.text: Tato cheyabe tzet chiwalan tinan̈ hanin heDiosal intiꞌan, mach hipo cheyute heba, ẍiayoj.

content: Kꞌinalo ta oc ebnaj Israel yin̈ huneꞌ xewbal tuꞌ yu naj Josué machim tzotel Comam Dios yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal bay ayon̈ tiꞌ.
Yuxin ay huneꞌ xewbal chakꞌ Comam tet macta yetxa Comam yehi.
Yuxin macta chiocto yul huneꞌ xewbal chakꞌ Comam tiꞌ chixewcano yin̈ sunil ismunil, hacaꞌ yu isxew Comam yet lahwi iswatxꞌencano huneꞌ yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.
Yuxin jakꞌaweco yin̈ cocꞌul jocto yin̈ huneꞌ xewbal chakꞌ Comam, yun̈e machi hunujon̈ chicobeybaln̈e isbeybal ebnaj man̈cꞌom tuꞌ.

Yuto Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios caw itzitz sunil chisje yu, chikꞌaxpon yul janma hacaꞌ hunu chꞌen espada cabeb yeh. Istzotiꞌ Comam tuꞌ chiapni yin̈ janma yeb yin̈ conabal yeb yin̈ tzet jehi. Chisyenilo tzet chiecꞌ yin̈ conabal yeb yin̈ janma, ta cꞌul maca mach cꞌuloj.
Sunil tzet watxꞌebil yu Comam Dios, machi hunu chu yeban isba sata Comam. Sunil tzet ye tuꞌ haban ye yul sat Comam, Comam bay chijal tzettaj chicowatxꞌe.
Comam Jesús haꞌ chitzotel jin̈ tet Comam Dios
Comam Jesús Iscꞌahol Comam Dios, xameltzo satcan̈, haꞌ chitzotel jin̈ tet Comam Dios, yuto yahawil sacerdote ye Comam. Yuxin yilal colin̈ban coba yin̈ cuybanil bay ayco janma.

Wal Comam yahawil sacerdote tuꞌ chu istzꞌay iscꞌul jin̈ yin̈ coyaꞌtajil, yuto hayet yecꞌ Comam yin̈ isnimanil coxol caw txꞌiꞌal ilwebal hul yiban̈ hacaꞌ ej ilwebal chul jiban̈, yajaꞌ machi bay yaco ismul Comam.
Yuxin yin̈ sunilojab janma chon̈hitzico iscꞌatan̈ Comam Dios Jahawil, Comam caw xahan ayon̈ yu, haxinwal chitzꞌaypaxo iscꞌul jin̈ cat con̈iscolnilo yin̈ej isyaꞌtajil chihul jin̈.
